captures.description: THE BATTERY READ AT ITS LEDGER; THE SELF-CORRECTION CARRIED AS THE FINDING: asked for the arguments of Inversion Battery v0.3, grounded in the text, ChatGPT reads #1456 (Goodreads ×8) through what v0.3 licenses: directional asymmetry (0.838 against a reversed AUC it gives as 0.243, and the GMM's 0.873 and 0.319); the fixed-weight score ablation overturning v0.2's 'architecture changes the orientation'; teacher–student rank 0.904 with half the top one percent lost; architecture order reversing across encodings; miss overlap unstable; complexity needing a common coordinate basis; the NAE closed with a handoff, the sampler unconverged; and the accounting, two confirmed, two partly, six missed, one not run, one closed, seventeen deviations. It reads the published failures as the method.
